title: Roadmap Bridge: Dependency Resilience Patterns & Cutover Playbook
creator: Maya Chen
description: Problem: Roadmap launches across multiple teams (Eng, Design, Security, Infra) are still failing due to ad-hoc dependency handoffs, ambiguous ownership during cutovers, and lack of automated health signals. Goal: Create a compact, operational "Roadmap Bridge" — a set of resilience patterns, ownership lanes, telemetry contracts, and a cutover playbook that product teams can adopt per initiative. The deliverable is a pattern catalog + automation templates (health checks, gating rules, escalation knobs) + a one-page cutover checklist to be included in every initiative PR. Success metrics: reduce cross-team outage incidents during launches by 40% and decrease dependency-related rollout delays by 30% by Q1 2026.
acceptance_criteria: Pattern catalog with 6 resilience patterns (contracted fallback, graceful degradation, model-variant fallback, region fallthrough, read-only mode, feature-flagged rollbacks) documented and reviewed by Eng/Security/Design
Telemetry contract: standardized health signals (latency P50/P95, error budget burn, KV-cache hit rate, downstream dependency latency) with sample Grafana dashboard and alert thresholds
Cutover playbook: a one-page checklist + automated gating job in CI that verifies pre-launch health signals and blocks rollout if thresholds breached
Ownership lanes defined per pattern with an escalation tree and on-call responsibilities for the 72-hour launch window
Two pilot initiatives (one Hosted API feature, one Dedicated capacity change) complete the playbook during their rollout and report learnings
